rationale: Y's structured claim-verified/refuted methodology tracks the actual PR thread closely, independently rediscovering that the primary-rank test still hardcodes the same rank assumption yuanheng-zhao flagged, that the extra_args gap in RequestBatchSamplingParamsKey leaves asukaqaq-s's CFG/shape concern only partially resolved, and that docs weren't updated for the new None-steps allowance — all tight matches to ground-truth threads.
